display.purpose: Hero and page headlines. Heavy, tightly tracked, often with one gold-ink word.

body.purpose: Prose in Dim; measure capped at 60 to 75ch.

label.purpose: The machine voice: kickers, code, API tags, identifiers, status. Always monospace.

shadows.name: gold-hover-glow
shadows.purpose: Interactive cards and primary buttons on hover: warmth, not just shadow.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Inputs and controls on focus, paired with a gold-shifted border.

shadows.name: floating-drop
shadows.purpose: The only resting shadow: window mock, dropdown menus, popovers.

shadows.name: mark-glow
shadows.purpose: The brand mark, so the W reads as a lit tile.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Default easing for lifts and state transitions. Ease out, no bounce.

motion.name: dur-fast
motion.purpose: Hover lifts, border and background shifts.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one warm object in a view: the primary call to action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(150deg, oklch(0.84 0.135 79), oklch(0.78 0.14 66)); color: oklch(0.145 0.02 265); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.96rem; padding: 0.72rem 1.3rem; border: none; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 16px 40px -12px oklch(0.84 0.135 79 / 0.8); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.84 0.135 79 / 0.35); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The quieter of two adjacent actions. Border, no glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.02); color: oklch(0.97 0.008 265); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.96rem; padding: 0.72rem 1.3rem; border: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 0.09); border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s, background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.2); background: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.05); }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Text field on a raised surface; gold ring on focus, no layout shift.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: oklch(0.185 0.022 265); color: oklch(0.97 0.008 265); font: inherit; font-size: 0.98rem; padding: 0.8rem 1rem; border: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 0.09); border-radius: 10px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.58 0.016 265); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.84 0.135 79 / 0.6); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.84 0.135 79 / 0.12); }

components.name: Kicker
components.description: The signal eyebrow: monospace label with a live pulsing gold dot.
components.css: .ds-kicker { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.78rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: oklch(0.9 0.11 82); } .ds-kicker::before { content: ''; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: oklch(0.84 0.135 79); box-shadow: 0 0 10px 1px oklch(0.84 0.135 79); animation: ds-pulse 2.6s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%,100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.35; } }

components.name: API Tag
components.description: Monospace tag naming an API surface or capability.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.76rem; color: oklch(0.72 0.018 265); padding: 0.28rem 0.6rem; border: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 0.09); border-radius: 7px; background: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.02); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Raised surface, flat at rest, lifts and glows gold on hover.
components.html:
01

Chat

A conversation that remembers context and streams every reply.
components.css: .ds-card { display: block; text-decoration: none; background: oklch(0.185 0.022 265); border: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 0.09); border-radius: 16px; padding: 1.4rem 1.5rem; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), border-color 0.18s, box-shadow 0.25s, background 0.18s; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); border-color: oklch(0.84 0.135 79 / 0.45); background: oklch(0.22 0.024 265); box-shadow: 0 26px 52px -30px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.85), 0 0 44px -24px oklch(0.84 0.135 79 / 0.5); } .ds-card-n { font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.85rem; color: oklch(0.58 0.016 265); } .ds-card-h { margin: 0.6rem 0 0.4rem; font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: oklch(0.97 0.008 265); } .ds-card-p { margin: 0; font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.5; color: oklch(0.72 0.018 265); }

components.name: The Window (signature)
components.description: The brand's defining element: a literal browser window with chrome and a framed, lit interior. Used as hero mock and featured-card preview.
components.html:
chat
Summarize WindowLLM in one line.
A browser API that lets any site use your own AI, with your keys sealed.
components.css: .ds-window { max-width: 320px; border: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 0.09); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; background: linear-gradient(180deg, oklch(0.22 0.024 265), oklch(0.145 0.02 265)); box-shadow: 0 22px 46px -28px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.8); } .ds-window-chrome { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; padding: 0.55rem 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 0.09); } .ds-window-chrome i { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.14); } .ds-window-chrome span { margin-left: auto; font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.7rem; color: oklch(0.58 0.016 265); } .ds-window-body { padding: 0.85rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-msg { font-size: 0.82rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.72rem; border-radius: 11px; max-width: 88%; line-height: 1.42; } .ds-msg.user { align-self: flex-end; color: oklch(0.145 0.02 265); background: linear-gradient(150deg, oklch(0.84 0.135 79), oklch(0.78 0.14 66)); } .ds-msg.bot { align-self: flex-start; color: oklch(0.72 0.018 265); background: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.04); border: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 0.09); } .ds-caret { display: inline-block; width: 6px; height: 0.9em; vertical-align: -0.1em; margin-left: 2px; background: oklch(0.84 0.135 79); animation: ds-blink 1.1s steps(1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-blink { 0%,50% { opacity: 1; } 50.01%,100% { opacity: 0; } }

narrative.overview: WindowLLM is a warm light falling through a dark blueprint. The product's whole idea is a window a site opens onto the user's own AI, so the interface makes that window literal: a dark slate ground, a faint engineering grid, and warm gold light spilling in from the top-left as if through glass. Gold is the light inside the vault; everything else is the room around it, kept quiet so the light reads. The system is dark by conviction, not fashion, the scene of a developer evaluating a sovereignty tool: focused, nocturnal, wanting to trust what they see. Confidence comes from precision, not decoration. It rejects the generic AI-SaaS look and rejects dependency itself: no web fonts, no third-party requests, the sovereignty it sells applied to itself.
keyCharacteristics: Warm gold on deep blue-slate, dark by default.
The browser window as a recurring literal motif (grid, light, chrome, frame).
Flat surfaces at rest; light and lift only on interaction.
System sans for substance, monospace for signals (kickers, code, API tags).
Self-contained: no external fonts, scripts, or network calls.

rules.name: The One Warm Signal Rule
rules.body: Gold is the only warm hue on the screen and it stays rare: primary action, brand, and the single live accent, not decoration. If two gold things compete for attention in one view, one is wrong.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: No pure black, no pure white. Every neutral is tinted toward the blue-slate hue (265) at low chroma. #000 and #fff are forbidden.

rules.name: The Machine-Voice Rule
rules.body: Monospace means literal machinery: code, an API call, a kicker, an identifier. Never set prose or a heading in mono; never set an API name in the sans.

rules.name: The Gold Emphasis Rule
rules.body: Emphasis inside a heading is one word recolored to Gold Ink, not italic, not underline, never a gradient across the text.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Touched Rule
rules.body: A resting surface has a border and a tonal step, never a shadow. Shadow and lift appear only on hover, focus, or genuine float.

dos: Do keep gold rare and singular: one primary action, one live accent per view.
Do tint every neutral toward the blue-slate hue (265) at low chroma; use OKLCH for all color.
Do set kickers, code, API names, and identifiers in monospace, and prose in the system sans.
Do keep resting surfaces flat with a hairline border; reveal shadow and lift only on hover, focus, or genuine float.
Do reach for the window motif (chrome bar, grid, warm light) when a surface should feel like the product.
Do vary spacing and card size for rhythm; differentiate cards with numbers, tags, and real copy.
Do keep everything self-contained: system fonts, inline SVG, no third-party requests.
donts: Don't use em dashes in UI copy, or double hyphens. Use commas, colons, semicolons, periods, or parentheses.
Don't load web fonts, external scripts, or any third-party asset.
Don't ship the generic AI-SaaS look: no purple-to-blue hero gradients, no neon-on-black, no glassmorphism as a default surface.
Don't build a wall of identical icon-heading-text cards. Differentiate, feature, and vary.
Don't use background-clip: text gradient headings; emphasize with a single Gold Ink word instead.
Don't use #000 or #fff, or an untinted gray anywhere.
Don't put a colored border-left or border-right stripe on cards, callouts, or alerts; use a full hairline border or a tinted fill.
Don't give a resting card a drop shadow, or let a second gold element compete with the primary action.
